scope.summary: Preview plugin that builds, tests, diagnoses, upgrades, deploys, binds, verifies, and inventories Power Apps component framework (PCF) code components for model-driven apps, with guided setup for Power Pages standard field controls and canvas apps.

bundledScripts.purpose: Vendored copy of the model-apps headless Dataverse SDK bundle, kept in sync by scripts/validate-plugin-copies.js.

externalNetworkCalls: Dataverse Web API (solution import, form binding, and verification)
npm registry during PCF project scaffolding and build

dependencies.name: Node.js and npm
dependencies.description: PCF projects are scaffolded and built with the pcf-scripts toolchain from npm.

dependencies.name: PAC CLI and .NET SDK
dependencies.description: Solution packaging, deployment, and package smoke tests use PAC CLI and the .NET SDK.

dependencies.name: Power Apps component framework for canvas apps
dependencies.description: Canvas use requires an admin to enable the setting per environment in the Power Platform admin center.

dependencies.name: Dataverse environment with customizer rights
dependencies.description: Deploying and binding components writes solutions and form customizations into the target environment.

technologies.name: Power Apps component framework
technologies.usedFor: Code component runtime the plugin builds for.

exceptions: Not assessed. Generated PCF components render inside model-driven, canvas, and Power Pages hosts; EDS applicability per host has not been reviewed.

blockers: Internal owner and support channel are not assigned.
Skills, agents, hooks, and bundled scripts are not reviewed against Equinor guidance.
Upstream marks the plugin as Preview with no recipe runtime-certified.
Deploys solutions and binds components into Dataverse environments, so production-system interaction is possible by default.
Technology Radar status is unknown for the Power Apps component framework.
CodeQL: incomplete string escaping in `scripts/lib/source-literals.js` (2 alerts). The file is a verified copy of the model-apps module, so the fix must land there upstream.

evidence.summary: Initial record after the plugin arrived in the fork through upstream sync 2026-10-15 (pcf v1.0.0). The upstream 1DS telemetry stack was excluded: scripts/lib/telemetry/, the skill-pretool and user-prompt telemetry hooks and their hooks.json registrations, and the /telemetry skill are not present in this fork.
All tests pass once the repository wiring (marketplace entry, root README entry, pcf-projects workflow) from the alignment change is present.

notes: Initial tracked-tier record only. Publication is deferred until a detailed review exists. Upstream's pcf-matrix-drift scheduled workflow is not carried in this fork pending an owner decision.
